table_semantics.description: Records of individual shipments linked to orders, including carrier, tracking number, shipping and delivery dates, and status.

shipment_id.description: Unique identifier for the shipment record.

order_id.description: Identifier of the order associated with the shipment.

tracking_number.description: Carrier‑provided tracking number for the shipment.

carrier.description: Name of the shipping carrier handling the shipment.

shipped_date.description: Date when the shipment was dispatched.

delivered_date.description: Date when the shipment was delivered to the customer (nullable).

shipment_status.description: Current status of the shipment (e.g., SHIPPED, DELIVERED).
